post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry intraday stop/target/time-stop/urgency thresholds on the same observed ledger. Next alpha work needs newly generated post-contract closed rows, then a shared default-off exit/risk policy Gate 1-4 test.
